Field/Scenario: Create valid term insurance policy (happy path)
Preconditions: User logged in; on Term Insurance module add form
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Term Insurance module. 2. Click Add. 3. Fill all required fields with valid data. 4. Submit form.
Test Data: insurerName=LIC, policyNumber=LIC-TI-90210, sumAssured=10000000, premiumAmount=12500, premiumFrequency=ANNUAL, policyStartDate=2024-01-15, policyEndDate=2054-01-15, nextPremiumDueDate=2027-01-15, is80CDeductible=true
Expected Result: Record saved successfully; appears in Term Insurance list with correct values; no error shown.

Preconditions: A term insurance record exists (TI-001 data)
Test Steps: 1. Open existing record. 2. Change premiumAmount and premiumFrequency. 3. Save.
Test Data: premiumAmount changed from 12500 to 15000; premiumFrequency changed from ANNUAL to MONTHLY
Expected Result: Record updates successfully; new values persisted and reflected in list view.

Expected Result: Field rejects non-numeric input; validation error shown (expects BigDecimal); record not saved.

Field/Scenario: Wrong data type in numeric field premiumAmount
Test Steps: 1. Enter alphabetic text into premiumAmount field. 2. Submit.
Expected Result: Field rejects non-numeric input; validation error shown; record not saved.

Preconditions: On add form / API call bypassing UI dropdown
Test Steps: 1. Submit request with premiumFrequency outside allowed set. 2. Observe response.
Expected Result: Server rejects value not in {MONTHLY,QUARTERLY,ANNUAL}; validation error returned; record not saved.

Test Steps: 1. Enter malformed date string. 2. Submit.
Expected Result: Field rejects unparsable LocalDate format; validation error shown.

Test Steps: 1. Enter 0 for sumAssured. 2. Fill rest of required fields validly. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: Depending on business rule, either saved with 0 sum assured (edge accepted) or rejected as illogical; verify actual behavior matches documented expectation (record with sumAssured=0 should raise a business-rule warning since insurance with zero cover is meaningless).

Test Steps: 1. Enter -500000 for sumAssured. 2. Submit.
Expected Result: Negative sum assured should be rejected as invalid business input; validation error expected.

Test Steps: 1. Enter 0 for premiumAmount. 2. Submit remaining valid data.
Expected Result: Zero premium accepted only if genuinely a fully-paid-up policy; otherwise flagged; verify app behavior explicitly.

Test Steps: 1. Enter -1000 for premiumAmount. 2. Submit.
Expected Result: Negative premium should be rejected; validation error expected.

Test Steps: 1. Enter very large number for sumAssured. 2. Submit.
Expected Result: Value accepted as BigDecimal without overflow/truncation; stored and displayed precisely.

Test Steps: 1. Set policyStartDate and policyEndDate to the same date. 2. Submit.
Expected Result: Business rule violation: policyEndDate must be strictly after policyStartDate; error/warning expected, record should not be treated as a valid multi-year term policy.

Test Steps: 1. Set policyEndDate earlier than policyStartDate. 2. Submit.
Expected Result: Validation error / business rule failure: end date before start date is invalid; record not saved or flagged clearly.

Field/Scenario: policyEndDate exactly one day after policyStartDate (minimum valid duration)
Test Steps: 1. Set policyEndDate = policyStartDate + 1 day. 2. Submit.
Expected Result: Record saved (technically valid per date ordering) though such a short term policy is unusual; no false rejection.

Test Steps: 1. Set nextPremiumDueDate earlier than policyStartDate. 2. Submit.
Expected Result: Business rule violation: nextPremiumDueDate should fall between policyStartDate and policyEndDate; validation warning/error expected.

Test Steps: 1. Set nextPremiumDueDate later than policyEndDate. 2. Submit.
Expected Result: Business rule violation: due date beyond policy validity is logically inconsistent; should be flagged.

Preconditions: On add form, checkbox not touched
Test Steps: 1. Leave is80CDeductible unchecked. 2. Submit valid record.
Expected Result: Field defaults to false/unchecked; saved correctly as false; no impact on required-field validation since checkbox is optional.

Test Steps: 1. Enter SQL injection string into insurerName. 2. Submit.
Expected Result: Input is treated as literal text (parameterized queries/ORM); no SQL execution; record saved with literal string or safely rejected by input validation; no data loss or schema change.

Test Steps: 1. Enter script tag payload into policyNumber. 2. Submit. 3. View record in list/detail view.
Expected Result: Value is stored and rendered as escaped text, not executed as script; no alert/popup triggers in UI; output-encoded on display.

Field/Scenario: XSS payload in insurerName via HTML injection
Test Steps: 1. Enter HTML img tag with onerror handler into insurerName. 2. Submit and view record.
Expected Result: Payload rendered as inert text; no script execution; page remains safe.

Preconditions: Record exists with nextPremiumDueDate in the past
Test Steps: 1. Set nextPremiumDueDate to a date before today. 2. View record / dashboard.
Expected Result: daysToPremium computed as negative value; UI surfaces this as 'overdue'/urgent styling (e.g., red badge); reminder indicates missed payment.

Test Steps: 1. Set nextPremiumDueDate to today's date. 2. View record.
Expected Result: daysToPremium=0; UI flags as 'due today', urgent visual treatment shown.

Test Steps: 1. Set nextPremiumDueDate to tomorrow. 2. View record.
Expected Result: daysToPremium=1; UI shows imminent-due warning (e.g., amber/orange indicator).

Test Steps: 1. Set nextPremiumDueDate to today+30 days. 2. View record.
Expected Result: daysToPremium=30; UI shows upcoming reminder, non-urgent styling (e.g., informational).

Test Steps: 1. Set nextPremiumDueDate to today+365 days. 2. View record.
Expected Result: daysToPremium=365; no urgent indicator; treated as far-future due date.

Field/Scenario: Verify term insurance never contributes to net worth totals
Preconditions: At least one term insurance record with non-zero sumAssured/premiumAmount exists
Test Steps: 1. Note current net worth total. 2. Add/edit a term insurance record with large sumAssured. 3. Recompute net worth. 4. Compare totals before and after.
Expected Result: Net worth total is unchanged after adding/editing the policy, confirming Bucket=NONE and value=null exclude term insurance from all asset/liability calculations.
